description: This file defines a UI component named 'Button' using the Lightning framework. It includes a template that displays text based on internal state, manages state variables for favorite status and text labels, and handles input to toggle the favorite status.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A UI button component that toggles between favorite and unfavorite states when input (enter key) is received.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes component state variables: isFavorited, favoriteText, unfavoriteText.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the 'enter' input event to toggle the isFavorited state.
